title: jurinea monocephala subsp. sintenisii
intro: Jurinea monocephala subsp. sintenisii, commonly known as Sintenis' Jurinea, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is a perennial herb with potential health benefits, particularly in its traditional use for treating fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Sintenis' Jurinea include anti-inflammatory and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's therapeutic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
